about.title: Driven by learning, *innovation & problem-solving.*
paragraphs: I'm a passionate **Full Stack Software Engineer** and **aspiring AI researcher**. I'm driven by a passion for learning, innovation, and problem-solving.

I hold an Engineering degree in Computer Science from **ENSA Kénitra**. I work across the stack, from machine learning models and LLM agents to backend services, web interfaces and the CI/CD pipelines that deliver them.
I currently work at **Orange Business**, building business web applications and an internal AI chatbot. I care about software quality, performance and measurable impact.

skills.title: The stack I *build with.*
skills.subtitle: From research notebooks to production systems: the tools I use to design, build and ship.

bullets: Design and develop business web applications using Python, PHP, JavaScript and SQL.
Optimized SQL/MariaDB queries and processing, contributing to an estimated **30% reduction in ticket processing time**.
Built an internal **AI-powered chatbot** automating recurring authentication & access-management support requests.
Implemented authentication, role-based access control and permission management.
Delivered through Git/GitLab, Docker and CI/CD in an Agile team, with code reviews and technical documentation.
Developed FastAPI services exposing computer vision capabilities through production REST APIs.
Contributed to an AI solution for **player re-identification** using computer vision.
Implemented a real-time data streaming pipeline with **Apache Kafka**.
Set up CI/CD workflows and deployed services on **AWS**.
Built Python automation scripts for VoIP invoice validation and data processing.
Designed REST APIs with Flask for backend services.
Contributed to an **MLOps pipeline** for customer detection with Airflow, MLflow and DVC.
Implemented monitoring with the ELK Stack and containerized services with Docker.
Developed a predictive maintenance model from infrared thermal images and vibration signals.
Built an API and interactive interface to expose model predictions.
Built sales forecasting models for SIM cards, dealers and scratch cards across three Moroccan telecom operators.
Data analysis and visualization with Python, Scikit-learn, R and Power BI.

projects.title: Projects that *ship.*
projects.subtitle: AI systems, full-stack platforms and interactive 3D web apps, most of them live: open the demo, read the code.

items.title: Katib Oumoumi
items.description: Generates Moroccan administrative documents (complaints, powers of attorney, contracts) in Word and PDF from admin templates and a dynamic form.
items.details: A vanilla JavaScript SPA with no framework and no build step, backed by **Supabase**. Users fill a dynamic form and download or share the document; an admin manages categories, document types and template fields.
highlights: Word and PDF generation from templates with typed placeholders
Admin dashboard: categories, document types, field types (ID card, dates, lists…)
Row Level Security: public read, admin-only write
Arabic right-to-left interface

items.title: Wood Depot — 3D Catalogue
items.description: The 3D timber yard is the catalogue: visitors walk through a procedural depot, inspect real-scale products, build a cart and request a quote on WhatsApp.
items.details: A single-page app for a timber depot in Sidi Yahya El Gharb. The whole yard is generated from a plan file (zones, racks, piles), with colliders and pathfinding. A classic catalogue, plan view and configurator expose the same products without 3D.
highlights: Procedural 3D world: instanced timber piles, procedural textures, no downloaded assets
Walkable depot with collisions, pathfinding and a minimap
Cart and **WhatsApp quote** flow; catalogue, plan view and configurator
Unit tests for layout, collisions, navigation and quotes; single-file build

items.title: Fidāʾī — Morocco 1945
items.description: A third-person survival open-world RPG in the browser, set in Morocco in 1945 under the French Protectorate. Playable in English and Moroccan Darija.
items.details: You play Driss, a young resistance fighter. Survive (hunger, thirst), loot and craft, fight with five weapons, stay unseen from guards with vision cones, hunt, trade, camp and grow six skills, all in a procedural open world rendered with **Three.js**.
highlights: Stealth AI with vision cones and detection meters; daylight changes guard sight
Survival, crafting, trading, hunting and camping systems
Bilingual: English and Moroccan Darija (Arabic script, right-to-left)
TypeScript + Vite, deployed on GitHub Pages

items.title: Café-Restaurant — 3D Visit
items.description: Walk into a Moroccan café-restaurant in 3D, find each dish where it is served, build an order and send it by WhatsApp. Every page also works without 3D.
items.details: The 3D space is the menu: the pass, the pastry case, the bar, the drinks fridge. Visitors inspect dishes, choose options, pick a table in 3D or on the 2D plan, and hand the order to the restaurant.
highlights: Menu ordering with option groups, line totals and a WhatsApp hand-off
Table selection in 3D and on a 2D plan; QR **table mode** (#table-5)
Live open/closed badge computed in Africa/Casablanca time; Ramadan mode
51 unit tests + headless end-to-end journeys (desktop, 390px touch, Arabic RTL)

items.title: SKYWAY — 3D Flight Simulator
items.description: A free 3D flight simulator in the browser: take off, navigate with instruments and radar, and complete missions.
items.details: A browser flight simulator with a cockpit HUD, radar, engine and fuel systems, missions and records, built with **WebGL**.
highlights: Flight model with throttle, autonomy, drift and turbulence readouts
Radar, navigation route and mission system
Runs in any modern browser, deployed on GitHub Pages

items.title: TopoGIS 3D
items.description: A topographic survey and analysis tool in one HTML file: GPS, OpenStreetMap buildings, parcels, measurements, relief, contour lines and elevation profiles.
items.details: A CAD-like GIS that runs entirely in the browser, with no server, build step or required API key. Objects are stored in planar UTM coordinates.
highlights: Drawing and editing tools with snapping, layers and orthogonal mode
Distances (planar and geodesic), areas, earthworks and equal-area subdivision
DXF import/export, GeoJSON export, PNG plans with title block
Optional real-time collaboration relay (Node.js, no dependencies)

items.title: Personal Finance Tracker
items.description: Track income, expenses, rental income against a loan and a savings goal, with charts, quick insights and opt-in monthly AI advice.
items.details: A static app backed by **Supabase** (auth, Postgres with Row Level Security, Edge Functions). A scheduled job asks an LLM for personalised monthly advice.
highlights: Quick transactions, search, filters and CSV export
Rule-based insights: savings rate, rising expenses, loan repayment pace
Monthly **AI advice** via Supabase Edge Functions and a GitHub Actions schedule
Single active session, 30-day inactivity logout, light/dark theme

items.title: DarnaLux Concierge
items.description: A production-oriented monorepo for a short-term rental concierge platform: web app, mobile app and shared business logic.
items.details: Owners estimate their rental income and hand over management. The monorepo shares business logic between the web (React + Vite) and mobile (Expo / React Native) apps.
highlights: Monorepo with a shared core package for business logic
React + Vite + TypeScript web app; Expo / React Native mobile
Supabase backend, CI/CD with GitHub Actions

items.title: School Store Manager
items.description: Point of sale, stock and invoicing for a school store: barcode scanning, client discounts, sales reports and a demo account.
items.details: A **Vue 3** single-page app with a pluggable data layer: the same interface runs on **Supabase**, Firebase, SQLite (sql.js) or browser storage, chosen by one environment variable.
highlights: Point of sale with **barcode scanning** (camera or Datalogic scanner) and thermal receipt printing
Invoices with partial payments, per-client discounts and outstanding balances
Sales reports by period, best sellers and **CSV export**
Bulk import from CSV, JSON, Excel, SQL or Access; manager and agent roles; French, English, Spanish and Arabic

items.title: ThreadLab — T-Shirt Store
items.description: A premium T-shirt store front with a product picker and WhatsApp ordering.

items.title: Intelligent Medical Assistant
items.description: Dell Technologies competition: an assistant for healthcare professionals that answers questions from medical documents (RAG) and analyses medical images.
items.details: Built for the **Dell Technologies competition**. Doctors chat with an assistant that retrieves answers from the knowledge base and patient files, and upload medical images that **YOLOv8** models detect and segment. Patients, history, medications, lab results and visit notes are managed in the same app.
highlights: **RAG pipeline**: LlamaIndex + Ollama (LLaMA) with nomic-embed-text embeddings and a ChromaDB vector store, streaming answers
**Medical imaging**: YOLOv8 detection and segmentation models (e.g. blood cells, COVID detection) served through the API
**Next.js** web app (chat, patients, dashboard, image analysis, files) + React Native mobile app
Flask / FastAPI backend with JWT auth, MongoDB, Docker Compose and GitLab CI

items.title: AI-Driven Cache Benchmark
items.description: Benchmarks AI-driven cache eviction policies on Magento shop traffic, from classic LRU/ARC/LIRS to learned eviction and semantic caching.
items.details: A research toolkit with a Python core, a Magento traffic generator, official CACHEUS/LeCaR/ARC/LIRS code, learned eviction in the style of DRL-Cache, a semantic cache, CACHEUS++ and a PHP module for Magento 1, plus a local web UI to run experiments.
highlights: Experts (LRU, LFU, GDSF) arbitrated by regret minimisation (LeCaR / CACHEUS)
Learned eviction: a small NumPy network exported to JSON and reused in PHP
Reproducible experiments: separate training and evaluation seeds
Web interface to configure and run benchmarks without the command line

items.title: Student Records Management Platform
items.description: A web platform managing the full lifecycle of student records, with scheduled processing, SFTP document exchange and notification workflows.
highlights: Automated scheduled processing of records
Document exchange through SFTP and object storage (MinIO)
Notification workflows; deployed with Docker behind Nginx

items.title: Predictive Maintenance, OCP
items.description: Predicts faults on industrial stacker machines from infrared thermal images and vibration signals, served through an API and a dashboard.
highlights: VGG16 classification of motor fault states from thermal images
Metaheuristics for hyperparameter optimisation
FastAPI prediction service + Streamlit operator interface

items.title: Emotion Detection Application
items.description: Image-based emotion recognition using VGG16 transfer learning and OpenCV, with a desktop interface.

items.title: Ticketus
items.description: A ticket management application: an ASP.NET Core 8 REST API with authentication and an Angular 17 front end.
highlights: ASP.NET Core 8 API: authentication, ticket management, Entity Framework migrations
Angular 17 front end (separate repository: Ticketus_Frontend)
SQL Server database

items.title: Telegram ChatGPT Bot
items.description: A Python Telegram bot that answers users with OpenAI's ChatGPT.
highlights: Telegram Bot API through pyTelegramBotAPI (telebot)
OpenAI completions with temperature 0.7
Command handlers (/start, /hello) and free conversation

items.title: Taquin (15-puzzle) Solver
items.description: Solves the sliding-tile puzzle with the A* and IDA* search algorithms and admissible heuristics.

items.title: Diet Recommendation System
items.description: Content-based diet and recipe recommendations (scikit-learn nearest neighbours, FastAPI, Streamlit). An open-source project by Zakaria Narjis that I deployed and studied.
items.details: Open-source project created by **Zakaria Narjis**. I ran it locally with Docker Compose and studied its content-based recommendation approach: nearest neighbours with cosine similarity over the nutritional values of 500,000 Food.com recipes.
highlights: Content-based recommendation: no cold-start problem
FastAPI recommendation service + Streamlit front end
Two-service Docker Compose deployment
